text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder has managed to leave
quite a mark
on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We've passed a significant milestone,
haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Trainer? It seems you've been
moved to
tears yet again.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You've been a leaky faucet ever since
the Arima
Kinen. There, there. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
By the way, there's something I would
like you to
see once you've finished
wiping your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, do you remember the promise I
wrote out
for you when we were getting
started?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to present you with a favorite
poem of
mine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just like before, Grass Wonder hands me
a sheet
of paper.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I open it up to see the warmest, gentlest
brush
strokes of calligraphy I have ever
seen. The poem
reads...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
When spring comes again, and the years
bring us
back here, may this day return.
Let us share a
joyous drink—with plum
petals in our hair.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'll make some delicious tea, so let's
celebrate
spring together each year.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And please, continue to walk this path
with me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We've still got a long, long way to go
together!
